backupPolicy.mechanism: scripts/backup.sh (host timer): encrypt + upload to BACKUP_DESTINATION (s3://|azure://|rclone) + backup_runs ledger row
backupPolicy.sidecarPolicy: compose --profile backup sidecar is a same-host convenience copy; deployments relying on it are labelled non-DR (the backup policy)

credentials.model: the credential policy split: neuronection_health_owner (DDL, POSTGRES_PASSWORD) + neuronection_health_app (DML, HA_DB_PASSWORD); owner DSN only in the one-shot migrate service
credentials.provisioning: migrate: scripts/provision_db.py pre (extensions, app role, grants, backup_runs) → alembic (publishes migration_state head marker) → checkpoint tables → post (default-privilege re-assert + DML-only verification)
